topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I heard the news today, and it's been hard to keep it together. The place where I've had so many good meals, where every visit felt like a celebration, is shutting down. I remember every meal there, the laughter, the talks. I keep thinking about all the times I took it for granted, how I could have gone there more often, or maybe brought more friends. Maybe I should have supported them in more ways. All those missed opportunities weigh on me. The restaurant won't just be a building closing; it's a part of my city's heart fading. I hope they know how much they meant to all of us, even if we didn't always show it.
